exit: 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage: pgtoolbox preview [--output text|json] [--cnpg-version 1.30] [--postgres-major N] OLD.yaml NEW.yaml

Reads two versions of CloudNativePG Cluster manifests (one file each, "-" for
stdin; multi-document YAML; Clusters matched by namespace and name; other
documents ignored) and says what applying NEW over OLD sets in motion. It never
contacts a cluster.

Exit codes:
  0  nothing disruptive: at most a configuration reload or a start
  1  disruptive: a restart, rollout, shutdown, major upgrade, a removed Cluster,
     a parameter the operator refuses, or a change whose effect is unknown
  2  invalid arguments or manifests

Options:
  -cnpg-version string
    	the CloudNativePG operator version (1.30, 1.31); without it the preview is unverified
  -output string
    	text or json (default "text")
  -postgres-major int
    	the PostgreSQL major, when the image tag and the status do not say it
